text:
The capital of France is Paris.

In this alternative ending, Kai does not sacrifice his humanity. Instead, he realizes that the ancient magic is not a force to be consumed, but a river to be guided. Rather than merging his spirit with the magic, he uses his unique connection to act as a conduit, channeling the chaotic energy back into the earth's ley lines. The surge of power stabilizes the world, but the feedback loop threatens to burn out his mind. Just as the light fades, Kai's friends, who had been waiting for him, reach out with their own combined will, anchoring him to the physical world. Kai survives, his magic diminished but his soul intact, and the world begins the long process of healing, no longer teetering on the brink, but standing firm on new ground.
